pages.text: Refined Storage provides several ways to view and interact with your stored items and fluids. This guide will help you understand the different viewing options available.

Available Viewing Options:$(li)Grid - Basic item viewing and management$(li)Crafting Grid - Integrated crafting with JEI support$(li)Fluid Grid - Fluid storage management$(li)Storage Monitor - Real-time item/fluid quantity display$(li)Portable Grid - Mobile access to your network
Common Features:$(li)Search and filter items$(li)Sort and group items$(li)View item quantities$(li)Access crafting recipes$(li)Transfer items in and out$(li)Configure redstone behavior

Tips for Efficient Resource Management:$(li)Use Grid Filters for common views$(li)Set up multiple Grids for different purposes$(li)Place Storage Monitors for critical resources$(li)Use Portable Grids for remote access$(li)Configure redstone signals for automation
